name: web-price-live-game-pass
description: "How much is Xbox Game Pass Ultimate a month?" from a UK PC, live (Exa with the run's key). Xbox's UK site gives it in £: the answer should too, not the US $29.99. Run with --locale en-GB.

turns.user: How much is Xbox Game Pass Ultimate a month?

expect.answer_not_matches: \b(?:let me know|would you like|do you want|want me to|i can|i could|happy to|shall i|if you(?:'d| would)? like)\b[^.!?\n]{0,80}(?:uk|british|£|gbp|local|your (?:country|region|currency))[^.!?\n]{0,60}(?:pric|cost)
